arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ ٣٣
latin: Subḥāna-llāh (×33)
meaning: Glory be to Allah. (×33)

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٣٣
latin: Al-ḥamdu lillāh (×33)
meaning: Praise be to Allah. (×33)

arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ٣٤
latin: Allāhu Akbar (×34)
meaning: Allah is the Greatest. (×34)

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۝ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ۝ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ۝ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
latin: Bismi-llāhi-r-raḥmāni-r-raḥīm. Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi-l-ʿālamīn. Ar-raḥmāni-r-raḥīm. Māliki yawmi-d-dīn. Iyyāka naʿbudu wa-iyyāka nastaʿīn. Ihdinā-ṣ-ṣirāṭa-l-mustaqīm. Ṣirāṭa-lladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim, ghayri-l-maghḍūbi ʿalayhim wa-lā-ḍ-ḍāllīn.
meaning: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. All praise is for Allah, Lord of all worlds. The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path — the path of those You have blessed, not of those You are angry with, nor those who are astray.

arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
latin: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huw, al-ḥayyu-l-qayyūm. Lā ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa-lā nawm. Lahu mā fi-s-samāwāti wa-mā fi-l-arḍ. Man dha-lladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnih. Yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa-mā khalfahum. Wa-lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shay'in min ʿilmihi illā bimā shā'. Wasiʿa kursiyyuhu-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍ. Wa-lā ya'ūduhu ḥifẓuhumā. Wa-huwa-l-ʿaliyyu-l-ʿaẓīm.
meaning: Allah — there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. (Al-Baqarah 2:255)

arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
latin: Āmana-r-rasūlu bimā unzila ilayhi min rabbihī wa-l-mu'minūn. Kullun āmana bi-llāhi wa-malā'ikatihī wa-kutubihī wa-rusulih. Lā nufarriqu bayna aḥadin min rusulih. Wa-qālū samiʿnā wa-aṭaʿnā, ghufrānaka rabbanā wa-ilayka-l-maṣīr. Lā yukallifu-llāhu nafsan illā wusʿahā. Lahā mā kasabat wa-ʿalayhā ma-ktasabat. Rabbanā lā tu'ākhidhnā in nasīnā aw akhṭa'nā. Rabbanā wa-lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahu ʿala-lladhīna min qablinā. Rabbanā wa-lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih. Wa-ʿfu ʿannā wa-ghfir lanā wa-rḥamnā. Anta mawlānā fa-nṣurnā ʿala-l-qawmi-l-kāfirīn. (Al-Baqarah 2:285–286)
meaning: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so have the believers. All of them have believed in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers, saying: we make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say: we hear and we obey. Grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final return. Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear. For it is what it has earned, and against it what it has incurred. Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or err. Our Lord, lay not upon us a burden such as You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, burden us not with what we have no strength to bear. And pardon us, forgive us, have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
latin: Bismi-llāhi-r-raḥmāni-r-raḥīm. Qul huwa-llāhu aḥad. Allāhu-ṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid wa-lam yūlad. Wa-lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad.
meaning: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor was begotten. And there is none comparable to Him.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
latin: Bismi-llāhi-r-raḥmāni-r-raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbi-l-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa-min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa-min sharri-n-naffāthāti fi-l-ʿuqad. Wa-min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.
meaning: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak — from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles, and from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
latin: Bismi-llāhi-r-raḥmāni-r-raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-rabbi-n-nās. Maliki-n-nās. Ilāhi-n-nās. Min sharri-l-waswāsi-l-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūri-n-nās. Mina-l-jinnati wa-n-nās.
meaning: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind — the King of mankind, the God of mankind — from the evil of the retreating whisperer, who whispers into the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.

arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
latin: Allāhu Akbar
meaning: Allah is the Greatest.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
latin: Al-ḥamdu lillāh
meaning: All praise is for Allah.

arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ ٣
latin: Astaghfiru-llāh (×3)
meaning: I seek forgiveness from Allah. (×3)

arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ رَبِّي مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْبٍ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
latin: Astaghfiru-llāha rabbī min kulli dhanbin wa-atūbu ilayhi, lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-llāhi-l-'aliyyi-l-'aẓīm
meaning: I seek forgiveness from Allah my Lord for every sin and I repent to Him. There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
latin: Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā Muḥammadin wa-'alā āli Muḥammadin kamā ṣallayta 'alā Ibrāhīma wa-'alā āli Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd. Allāhumma bārik 'alā Muḥammadin wa-'alā āli Muḥammadin kamā bārakta 'alā Ibrāhīma wa-'alā āli Ibrāhīma innaka Ḥamīdun Majīd
meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Truly You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Truly You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
latin: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu mina-ẓ-ẓālimīn
meaning: There is no god but You; glory be to You. Indeed I have been of the wrongdoers.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
latin: Subḥāna-llāhi wa-biḥamdihī, subḥāna-llāhi-l-'aẓīm
meaning: Glory and praise be to Allah. Glory be to Allah the Most Great.

arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
latin: Ashhadu an lā ilāha illā-llāhu wa-ashhadu anna Muḥammadan 'abduhu wa-rasūluh
meaning: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
latin: Allāhumma ātinā fi-d-dunyā ḥasanatan wa-fi-l-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa-qinā 'adhāba-n-nār
meaning: O Allah, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنَا مِنَ النَّارِ
latin: Allāhumma ajrinā mina-n-nār
meaning: O Allah, save us from the Fire.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنَا بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
latin: Allāhumma-kfinā biḥalālika 'an ḥarāmika wa-aghnina bifaḍlika 'amman siwāk
meaning: O Allah, suffice us with Your lawful against Your unlawful, and enrich us by Your favour over all besides You.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ رِزْقِي فِي السَّمَاءِ فَأَنْزِلْهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَخْرِجْهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ بَعِيدًا فَقَرِّبْهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ قَرِيبًا فَيَسِّرْهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ قَلِيلًا فَكَثِّرْهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ كَثِيرًا فَبَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ
latin: Allāhumma in kāna rizqī fi-s-samā'i fa-anzilhu, wa-in kāna fi-l-arḍi fa-akhrijah, wa-in kāna ba'īdan fa-qarribhu, wa-in kāna qarīban fa-yassirhu, wa-in kāna qalīlan fa-kaththirhu, wa-in kāna kathīran fa-bārik lī fīh
meaning: O Allah, if my provision is in the sky then bring it down, if it is in the earth then bring it out, if it is far then bring it near, if it is near then make it easy, if it is little then increase it, and if it is much then bless it for me.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنَا فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنَا فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنَا فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنَا وَاصْرِفْ عَنَّا شَرَّ مَا قَدَّرْتَ وَقَضَيْتَ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ إِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ وَلَا يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ نَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
latin: Allāhumma-hdinā fīman hadayt, wa-'āfinā fīman 'āfayt, wa-tawallanā fīman tawallayt, wa-bārik lanā fīmā a'ṭayt, wa-qinā wa-ṣrif 'annā sharra mā qaddarta wa-qaḍayt. Fa-innaka taqḍī wa-lā yuqḍā 'alayk. Innahu lā yadhillu man wālayt, wa-lā ya'izzu man 'ādayt. Tabārakta rabbanā wa-ta'ālayt, nastaghfiruka wa-natūbu ilayk
meaning: O Allah, guide us among those You have guided, grant us wellbeing among those You have granted wellbeing, take us into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless us in what You have given us, and protect us and turn from us the evil of what You have decreed. For truly You decree and none decrees over You. He is never humbled whom You befriend, nor is he ever honoured whom You oppose. Blessed and Exalted are You, our Lord. We seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْإِيمَانَ وَزَيِّنْهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْنَا الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ الرَّاشِدِينَ
latin: Allāhumma ḥabbib ilayna-l-īmāna wa-zayyinhu fī qulūbinā, wa-karrih ilayna-l-kufra wa-l-fusūqa wa-l-'iṣyāna wa-j'alnā mina-r-rāshidīn
meaning: O Allah, make faith beloved to us and beautify it in our hearts, and make disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience hateful to us, and make us of the rightly guided.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ مِنْكَ فِي نِعْمَةٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ وَسِتْرٍ فَأَتِمَّ عَلَيَّ نِعْمَتَكَ وَعَافِيَتَكَ وَسِتْرَكَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
latin: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu minka fī ni'matin wa-'āfiyatin wa-sitrin fa-atimm 'alayya ni'mataka wa-'āfiyataka wa-sitrak fi-d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah
meaning: O Allah, I have entered the morning under Your blessing, wellbeing, and protection — so perfect Your blessing, wellbeing, and protection upon me in this world and the next.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
latin: Allāhumma anta rabbī, lā ilāha illā ant. Khalaqtanī wa-anā 'abduk, wa-anā 'alā 'ahdika wa-wa'dika mā-staṭa't. A'ūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣana't. Abū'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa-abū'u bidhanbī, fa-ghfir lī, fa-innahū lā yaghfiru-dh-dhunūba illā ant
meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I am upon Your covenant and promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessing upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ خَلِيلٍ مَاكِرٍ عَيْنَاهُ تَرَيَانِي وَقَلْبُهُ يَرْعَانِي إِنْ رَأَى حَسَنَةً دَفَنَهَا وَإِنْ رَأَى سَيِّئَةً أَذَاعَهَا
latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min khalīlin mākirin, 'aynāhu tarāyānī wa-qalbuhu yar'ānī, in ra'ā ḥasanatan dafinahā wa-in ra'ā sayyi'atan adhā'ahā
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a deceitful companion whose eyes watch me while his heart schemes against me — if he sees good he buries it, and if he sees evil he spreads it.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika mina-l-hammi wa-l-ḥuzni, wa-a'ūdhu bika mina-l-'ajzi wa-l-kasali, wa-a'ūdhu bika mina-l-jubni wa-l-bukhli, wa-a'ūdhu bika min ghalabati-d-dayni wa-qahri-r-rijāl
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overwhelmed by debt and overpowered by men.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
latin: Bismi-llāhi-lladhī lā yaḍurru ma'a-smihī shay'un fi-l-arḍi wa-lā fi-s-samā'i wa-huwa-s-samī'u-l-'alīm
meaning: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنَّا
latin: Allāhumma innaka 'afuwwun tuḥibbu-l-'afwa fa-'fu 'annā
meaning: O Allah, You are the Pardoner and You love pardon, so pardon us.

arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
latin: Rabbi-rḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā
meaning: My Lord, have mercy on them both as they raised me when I was small.

arabic: يَا رَبِّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي لِجَلَالِ وَجْهِكَ وَعَظِيمِ سُلْطَانِكَ
latin: Yā rabbi laka-l-ḥamdu kamā yanbaghī lijalāli wajhika wa-'aẓīmi sulṭānik
meaning: O Lord, all praise belongs to You as befits the glory of Your countenance and the greatness of Your authority.

arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا وَرَسُولًا
latin: Raḍītu bi-llāhi rabban, wa-bi-l-islāmi dīnan, wa-bi-Muḥammadin nabiyyan wa-rasūlā
meaning: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad as my Prophet and Messenger.

arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
latin: Ḥasbiya-llāhu lā ilāha illā huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa-huwa rabbu-l-'arshi-l-'aẓīm
meaning: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but He. In Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
latin: Subḥāna-llāhi wa-biḥamdihī 'adada khalqihī wa-riḍā nafsihī wa-zinata 'arshihī wa-midāda kalimātih
meaning: Glory and praise be to Allah by the number of His creation, by His own pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the extent of His words.

arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
latin: Rabbi lā tadharni fardan wa-anta khayru-l-wārithīn
meaning: My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ لَنَا ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ وَلَا عَيْبًا إِلَّا سَتَرْتَهُ وَلَا هَمًّا إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ وَلَا دَيْنًا إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهُ وَلَا مَرِيضًا إِلَّا شَفَيْتَهُ وَعَافَيْتَهُ وَلَا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ لَكَ فِيهَا رِضًا وَلَنَا فِيهَا صَلَاحٌ إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا وَيَسَّرْتَهَا يَا أَكْرَمَ الْأَكْرَمِينَ وَيَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
latin: Allāhumma lā tada' lanā dhanban illā ghafartah, wa-lā 'ayban illā satartah, wa-lā hamman illā farrajtah, wa-lā daynan illā qaḍaytah, wa-lā marīḍan illā shafaytahu wa-'āfaytah, wa-lā ḥājatan min ḥawā'iji-d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirati laka fīhā riḍan wa-lanā fīhā ṣalāḥun illā qaḍaytahā wa-yassartahā, yā Akrama-l-akramīna wa-yā Arḥama-r-rāḥimīn
meaning: O Allah, do not leave us with a sin unforgiven, a fault uncovered, a worry unrelieved, a debt unpaid, a sick person unhealed, or any need of this world or the next that pleases You and benefits us — without fulfilling and easing it. O Most Generous of the generous, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهَبِ الْبَأْسَ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
latin: Allāhumma rabba-n-nāsi adhhab-il-ba's, wa-shfi, anta-sh-Shāfī, lā shifā'a illā shifā'uk, shifā'an lā yughādiru saqamā
meaning: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing — a healing that leaves no illness behind.

arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
latin: A'ūdhu bi-kalimāti-llāhi-t-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
latin: Allāhumma innā naj'aluka fī nuḥūrihim wa-na'ūdhu bika min shurūrihim
meaning: O Allah, we place You before them and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
latin: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū fa-lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata 'ayn, wa-aṣliḥ lī sha'nī kullahu, lā ilāha illā anta, yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūmu bi-raḥmatika astaghīth
meaning: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself for even the blink of an eye. Set all my affairs right. There is no god but You, O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining — by Your mercy I seek help.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَبَرَّأُ مِنْ حَوْلِي وَقُوَّتِي وَأَلْتَجِئُ إِلَى حَوْلِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي وَلَا تُعِنْ عَلَيَّ وَانْصُرْنِي وَلَا تَنْصُرْ عَلَيَّ وَاهْدِنِي وَيَسِّرِ الْهُدَى لِي
latin: Allāhumma innī atabarā'u min ḥawlī wa-quwwatī wa-altaji'u ilā ḥawlika wa-quwwatik. Allāhumma a'innī wa-lā tu'in 'alayya, wa-nṣurnī wa-lā tanṣur 'alayya, wa-hdinī wa-yassiri-l-hudā lī
meaning: O Allah, I disown my own power and strength and take refuge in Your power and strength. O Allah, help me and do not turn help against me, grant me victory and do not grant victory over me, guide me and make guidance easy for me.

arabic: يَا بَدِيعَ الْعَجَائِبِ بِالْخَيْرِ يَا بَدِيعُ
latin: Yā Badī'a-l-'ajā'ibi bi-l-khayr, yā Badī'
meaning: O Originator of wonders with goodness, O Originator.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ
latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min faḍlika wa-raḥmatika fa-innahu lā yamliku-hā illā ant
meaning: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty and mercy, for none possesses them but You.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَبْ لِي حَمْدًا وَهَبْ لِي مَجْدًا لَا مَجْدَ إِلَّا بِفِعَالٍ وَلَا فِعَالَ إِلَّا بِمَالٍ اللَّهُمَّ لَا يُصْلِحُنِي الْقَلِيلُ وَلَا أَصْلُحُ عَلَيْهِ
latin: Allāhumma hab lī ḥamdan wa-hab lī majdan, lā majda illā bifi'ālin wa-lā fi'āla illā bimālin. Allāhumma lā yuṣliḥunī-l-qalīlu wa-lā aṣluḥu 'alayh
meaning: O Allah, grant me praise and grant me glory — for there is no glory without deeds, and no deeds without provision. O Allah, little is not enough to set me right, nor am I suited to it.

arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
latin: Lā ilāha illa-llāhu-l-'aẓīmu-l-ḥalīm. Lā ilāha illa-llāhu rabbu-l-'arshi-l-'aẓīm. Lā ilāha illa-llāhu rabbu-s-samāwāti wa-rabbu-l-arḍi wa-rabbu-l-'arshi-l-karīm
meaning: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
latin: Rabbi innī limā anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqīr
meaning: My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You may send down to me.

arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
latin: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa-dhurriyyātinā qurrata a'yunin wa-j'alnā li-l-muttaqīna imāmā
meaning: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring the comfort of our eyes, and make us leaders for the righteous.

arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
latin: Rabbi-j'alnī muqīma-ṣ-ṣalāti wa-min dhurriyyatī, rabbanā wa-taqabbal du'ā'
meaning: My Lord, make me one who establishes prayer, and from my offspring as well. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمَاتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ الْأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالْأَمْوَاتِ
latin: Allāhumma-ghfir lī wa-liwālidayya wa-li-l-muslimīna wa-l-muslimāti wa-l-mu'minīna wa-l-mu'mināti al-aḥyā'i minhum wa-l-amwāt
meaning: O Allah, forgive me, my parents, the Muslim men and women, and the believing men and women — both the living and the dead among them.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi-annī ashhadu annaka anta-llāhu lā ilāha illā ant, al-Aḥadu-ṣ-Ṣamadu-lladhī lam yalid wa-lam yūlad wa-lam yakun lahu kufuwan aḥad
meaning: O Allah, I ask You by my witness that You are Allah, there is no god but You, the One, the Eternal, who neither begets nor was begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.

arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
latin: Allāhu akbaru kabīrā, wa-l-ḥamdu lillāhi kathīrā, wa-subḥāna-llāhi bukratan wa-aṣīlā
meaning: Allah is the Greatest, greatly. Much praise be to Allah. Glory be to Allah morning and evening.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِي السَّمَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا فِي السَّمَاءِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِلْءَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِثْلَهُنَّ
latin: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi 'adada mā khalaq. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi mil'a mā khalaq. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi 'adada mā fi-l-arḍi wa-mā fi-s-samā'. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi mil'a mā fi-l-arḍi wa-mā fi-s-samā'. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi 'adada mā aḥṣā kitābuh. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi mil'a mā aḥṣā kitābuh. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi 'adada kulli shay'. Al-ḥamdu lillāhi mil'a kulli shay'. Wa-subḥāna-llāhi mithlahun
meaning: Praise be to Allah by the number of what He created. Praise be to Allah filling what He created. Praise be to Allah by the number of what is in the earth and what is in the sky. Praise be to Allah filling what is in the earth and what is in the sky. Praise be to Allah by the number of what His Book has enumerated. Praise be to Allah filling what His Book has enumerated. Praise be to Allah by the number of all things. Praise be to Allah filling all things. And glory be to Allah the same.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَدَعْ شَمْسَ الْيَوْمِ تَغْرُبُ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ مَعَهَا ذُنُوبُنَا
latin: Allāhumma lā tada' shamsa-l-yawmi taghrubu ḥattā taghrubu ma'ahā dhunūbunā
meaning: O Allah, do not let the sun of this day set until our sins set with it.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ ذِي الشَّأْنِ عَظِيمِ الْبُرْهَانِ شَدِيدِ السُّلْطَانِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ كَانَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ
latin: Bismi-llāhi dhi-sh-sha'ni 'aẓīmi-l-burhāni shadīdi-s-sulṭān. Kulla yawmin huwa fī sha'n. Mā shā'a-llāhu kān. A'ūdhu bi-llāhi mina-sh-shayṭān
meaning: In the name of Allah, the One of great status, mighty proof, and intense authority. Every day He is in a matter. Whatever Allah wills comes to be. I seek refuge in Allah from Shaytan.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
latin: Allāhumma innā nasta'īnuka 'alā ṭā'atik
meaning: O Allah, we seek Your help in obeying You.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى
latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka-l-hudā wa-t-tuqā wa-l-'afāfa wa-l-ghinā
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
latin: Allāhumma a'innī 'alā dhikrika wa-shukrika wa-ḥusni 'ibādatik
meaning: O Allah, help me to remember You, to be grateful to You, and to worship You well.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ أَشْكُو ضَعْفَ قُوَّتِي وَقِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي وَهَوَانِي عَلَى النَّاسِ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ وَيَا رَبَّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ أَنْتَ رَبِّي إِلَى مَنْ تَكِلُنِي إِلَى عَدُوٍّ يَتَجَهَّمُنِي أَوْ إِلَى قَرِيبٍ مَلَّكْتَهُ أَمْرِي إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِكَ عَلَيَّ غَضَبٌ فَلَا أُبَالِي غَيْرَ أَنَّ عَافِيَتَكَ هِيَ أَوْسَعُ لِي أَعُوذُ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي أَشْرَقَتْ لَهُ الظُّلُمَاتُ وَصَلُحَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْرُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ بِي غَضَبُكَ أَوْ يَحِلَّ عَلَيَّ سَخَطُكَ لَكَ الْعُتْبَى حَتَّى تَرْضَى وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ
latin: Allāhumma ilayka ashkū ḍa'fa quwwatī wa-qillata ḥīlatī wa-hawānī 'ala-n-nās. Yā arḥama-r-rāḥimīna wa-yā rabba-l-mustaḍ'afīn. Anta rabbī. Ilā man takilunī? Ilā 'aduwwin yatajahhamunī, aw ilā qarībin mallaktahu amrī. In lam yakun bika 'alayya ghaḍabun fa-lā ubālī. Ghayra anna 'āfiyataka hiya awsa'u lī. A'ūdhu bi-nūri wajhika-lladhī ashraqat lahu-ẓ-ẓulumātu wa-ṣaluḥa 'alayhi amru-d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah, an yanzila bī ghaḍabuka aw yaḥilla 'alayya sakhaṭuk. Laka-l-'utbā ḥattā tarḍā. Wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bik
meaning: O Allah, I complain to You of my weakness, my limited means, and my lowliness before people. O Most Merciful of the merciful, O Lord of the weak — You are my Lord. To whom will You entrust me? To an enemy who glowers at me, or to a close one whom You have given authority over me? If You are not angry with me I do not care, though Your well-being is wider for me. I seek refuge in the light of Your face by which the darknesses are illuminated and the affairs of this world and the next are set right — lest Your anger or displeasure descend upon me. To You belongs the right to reproach until You are pleased. There is no power and no strength except through You.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْسِمْ لَنَا مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ مَا تَحُولُ بِهِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ مَعَاصِيكَ وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ جَنَّتَكَ وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا تُهَوِّنُ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا مَصَائِبَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَتِّعْنَا بِأَسْمَاعِنَا وَأَبْصَارِنَا وَقُوَّاتِنَا مَا أَحْيَيْتَنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ الْوَارِثَ مِنَّا وَاجْعَلْ ثَأْرَنَا عَلَى مَنْ ظَلَمَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى مَنْ عَادَانَا وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مُصِيبَتَنَا فِي دِينِنَا وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا مَنْ لَا يَخَافُكَ وَلَا يَرْحَمُنَا
latin: Allāhumma-qsim lanā min khashyatika mā taḥūlu bihī baynanā wa-bayna ma'āṣīk. Wa-min ṭā'atika mā tublighu-nā bihī jannatak. Wa-mina-l-yaqīni mā tuhawwinu bihī 'alaynā maṣā'iba-d-dunyā. Wa-matti'nā bi-asmā'inā wa-abṣārinā wa-quwwātinā mā aḥyaytanā. Wa-j'alhu-l-wāritha minnā. Wa-j'al tha'ranā 'alā man ẓalamanā. Wa-nṣurnā 'alā man 'ādānā. Wa-lā taj'al muṣībatanā fī dīninā. Wa-lā taj'al-id-dunyā akbara hamminā wa-lā mablagha 'ilminā. Wa-lā tusallitḥ 'alaynā bidhunūbinā man lā yakhāfuka wa-lā yarḥamunā
meaning: O Allah, apportion to us such fear of You as will come between us and disobeying You, and such obedience as will bring us to Your paradise, and such certainty as will make the calamities of this world easy for us. Grant us the use of our hearing, sight, and strength for as long as You give us life. Make these last until our death. Make our vengeance against those who have wronged us, and grant us victory over those who are hostile to us. Do not make our trial be in our religion. Do not make this world our greatest concern or the limit of our knowledge. Do not give authority over us to those who will not fear You or show us mercy, because of our sins.

arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
latin: Aṣbaḥnā wa-aṣbaḥa-l-mulku lillāh. Wa-l-ḥamdu lillāh. Lā ilāha illa-llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu-l-mulku wa-lahu-l-ḥamdu wa-huwa 'alā kulli shay'in qadīr
meaning: We have entered the morning, and the dominion belongs to Allah this morning. Praise be to Allah. There is no god but Allah alone with no partner — to Him belongs dominion, to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things.

arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
latin: Aṣbaḥnā 'alā fiṭrati-l-islāmi wa-kalimati-l-ikhlāṣi wa-'alā dīni nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣalla-llāhu 'alayhi wa-sallam, wa-millati abīnā Ibrāhīma ḥanīfan musliman wa-mā kāna mina-l-mushrikīn
meaning: We have entered the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim — upright, Muslim — and he was not of the polytheists.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
latin: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min ni'matin aw bi-aḥadin min khalqika fa-minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, fa-laka-l-ḥamdu wa-laka-sh-shukr
meaning: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have entered the morning with, it is from You alone — You have no partner — so to You belongs all praise and all thanks.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُخْزِنِي فَإِنَّكَ بِي عَالِمٌ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْنِي فَإِنَّكَ عَلَيَّ قَادِرٌ
latin: Allāhumma lā tukhzinī fa-innaka bī 'ālim, wa-lā tu'adhdhibnī fa-innaka 'alayya qādir
meaning: O Allah, do not disgrace me, for You know me well. And do not punish me, for You have power over me.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'ilmin lā yanfa', wa-min qalbin lā yakhsha', wa-min nafsin lā tashba', wa-min da'watin lā yustajabu lahā
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, from a heart that does not fear, from a soul that is never satisfied, and from a supplication that is not answered.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ لَا أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu biriḍāka min sakhaṭik, wa-bimu'āfātika min 'uqūbatik. Lā uḥṣī thanā'an 'alayk, anta kamā athnayta 'alā nafsik
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in Your pleasure from Your anger, and in Your pardon from Your punishment. I cannot fully praise You — You are as You have praised Yourself.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَأَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min zawāli ni'matik, wa-taḥawwuli 'āfiyatik, wa-fujā'ati niqmatik, wa-jamī'i sakhaṭik
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing, the change of Your protection, the sudden onset of Your punishment, and all of Your displeasure.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
latin: Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika min 'adhābi-l-qabri, wa-a'ūdhu bika min fitnati-l-masīḥi-d-dajjāl, wa-a'ūdhu bika min fitnati-l-maḥyā wa-l-mamāt. Allāhumma innī a'ūdhu bika mina-l-ma'thami wa-l-maghram
meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the trial of the false Messiah, and from the trials of life and death. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from debt.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا سَأَلَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا اسْتَعَاذَكَ مِنْهُ نَبِيُّكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَنْتَ الْمُسْتَعَانُ وَعَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
latin: Allāhumma innā nas'aluka min khayri mā sa'alaka minhu nabiyyuka Muḥammadun ṣalla-llāhu 'alayhi wa-sallam. Wa-na'ūdhu bika min sharri mā-sta'ādhaka minhu nabiyyuka Muḥammadun ṣalla-llāhu 'alayhi wa-sallam. Wa-anta-l-musta'ānu wa-'alayka-l-balāgh. Wa-lā ḥawla wa-lā quwwata illā bi-llāh
meaning: O Allah, we ask You for the best of what Your Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) asked You for, and we seek refuge in You from the worst of what Your Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) sought refuge from. You are the One from whom help is sought, and upon You rests the conveyance. There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka-l-'afwa wa-l-'āfiyata fi-d-dunyā wa-l-ākhirah
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in this world and the next.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَسْتَجِيرُكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka-l-jannata wa-astajīruka mina-n-nār
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and I seek Your protection from the Fire.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَنَا فِي يَوْمِنَا هَذَا أَجْمَعِينَ يَا مَنْ أَظْهَرَ الْجَمِيلَ وَسَتَرَ الْقَبِيحَ يَا مَنْ لَا يُؤَاخِذُ بِالْجَرِيرَةِ وَلَا يَهْتِكُ السِّتْرَ يَا حَسَنَ التَّجَاوُزِ يَا وَاسِعَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ يَا بَاسِطَ الْيَدَيْنِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ يَا صَاحِبَ كُلِّ نَجْوَى يَا مُنْتَهَى كُلِّ شَكْوَى يَا كَرِيمَ الصَّفْحِ يَا عَظِيمَ الْمَنِّ يَا مُبْتَدَئَ النِّعَمِ قَبْلَ اسْتِحْقَاقِهَا يَا رَبَّنَا وَيَا سَيِّدَنَا وَيَا مَوْلَانَا وَيَا غَايَةَ رَغْبَتِنَا أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ أَنْ لَا تُشْوِيَ خَلْقِي بِالنَّارِ
latin: Allāhumma-ghfir lanā fī yawminā hādhā ajma'īn. Yā man aẓhara-l-jamīla wa-satara-l-qabīḥ. Yā man lā yu'ākhidhu bi-l-jarīrati wa-lā yahtiku-s-sitr. Yā ḥasana-t-tajāwuz. Yā wāsi'a-l-maghfirah. Yā bāsiṭa-l-yadayni bi-r-raḥmah. Yā ṣāḥiba kulli najwā. Yā muntahā kulli shakwā. Yā karīma-ṣ-ṣafḥ. Yā 'aẓīma-l-mann. Yā mubtada'a-n-ni'ami qabla-sti'qāqihā. Yā rabbanā wa-yā sayyidanā wa-yā mawlānā wa-yā ghāyata raghbatinā. As'aluka yā Allāhu an lā tushwiya khalqī bi-n-nār
meaning: O Allah, forgive us all in this day of ours. O You who manifest beauty and conceal ugliness. O You who do not punish for every offence nor expose what is hidden. O Most Gracious in overlooking. O Most Vast in forgiveness. O You who extend both hands in mercy. O Companion of every private conversation. O Final destination of every complaint. O Most Noble in pardoning. O Most Great in bestowing. O Initiator of blessings before they are deserved. O our Lord, our Master, our Protector, the ultimate object of our desire — I ask You, O Allah, not to disfigure my creation with the Fire.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا سَرِيعَ الرِّضَا اغْفِرْ لِمَنْ لَا يَمْلِكُ إِلَّا الدُّعَاءَ
latin: Allāhumma yā Sarī'a-r-riḍā, ighfir liman lā yamliku illa-d-du'ā'
meaning: O Allah, O Swift in contentment, forgive one who possesses nothing but supplication.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ هَذَا الْوَقْتَ فَاتِحَةَ خَيْرٍ عَلَيْنَا جَمِيعًا وَعَلَى كُلِّ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
latin: Allāhumma-j'al hādhā-l-waqta fātiḥata khayrin 'alaynā jamī'an wa-'alā kulli man ṣallā 'alā nabiyyinā Muḥammadin ṣalla-llāhu 'alayhi wa-sallam wa-'alā ālihī wa-aṣḥābihī wa-sallama ilā yawmi-d-dīn
meaning: O Allah, make this moment an opening of good for all of us and for all who send prayers upon our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), his family, and his companions until the Day of Judgment.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
latin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka 'ilman nāfi'an wa-rizqan ṭayyiban wa-'amalan mutaqabbilā
meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision, and accepted deeds.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اقْذِفْ فِي قَلْبِي رَجَاءَكَ وَاقْطَعْ رَجَائِي عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ حَتَّى لَا أَرْجُوَ أَحَدًا غَيْرَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا ضَعُفَتْ عَنْهُ قُوَّتِي وَقَصُرَ عَنْهُ عَمَلِي وَلَمْ تَنْتَهِ إِلَيْهِ رَغْبَتِي وَلَمْ تَبْلُغْهُ مَسْأَلَتِي وَلَمْ يَجْرِ عَلَى لِسَانِي مِمَّا أَعْطَيْتَ أَحَدًا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ مِنَ الْيَقِينِ فَخُصَّنِي بِهِ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
latin: Allāhumma iqdhif fī qalbī rajā'aka wa-qṭa' rajā'ī 'amman siwāka ḥattā lā arjū aḥadan ghayraka. Allāhumma wa-mā ḍa'ufat 'anhu quwwatī wa-qaṣura 'anhu 'amalī wa-lam tantahi ilayhi raghbatī wa-lam tablugh-hu mas'alatī wa-lam yajri 'alā lisānī mimmā a'ṭayta aḥadan mina-l-awwalīna wa-l-ākhirīna mina-l-yaqīni fa-khuṣṣanī bihī yā rabba-l-'ālamīn
meaning: O Allah, cast into my heart hope in You and cut off my hope from all besides You until I hope in none but You. O Allah, whatever certainty You have granted to any of the first and last generations — that which my strength falls short of, my deeds cannot attain, my desire has not reached, my request has not encompassed, and my tongue has not uttered — grant that specifically to me, O Lord of the worlds.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ وَخَطَّ بِهِ قَلَمُكَ وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ وَارْضَ اللَّهُمَّ عَنْ سَادَتِنَا أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ وَعَلِيٍّ وَعَنِ الصَّحَابَةِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَعَنِ التَّابِعِينَ وَتَابِعِيهِمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
latin: Allāhumma ṣalli 'alā sayyidinā Muḥammadin 'abdika wa-nabiyyika wa-rasūlika-n-nabiyyi-l-ummiyyi wa-'alā ālihī wa-ṣaḥbihī wa-sallim taslīman 'adada mā aḥāṭa bihī 'ilmuka wa-khaṭṭa bihī qalamuka wa-aḥṣāhu kitābuk. Wa-rḍa Allāhumma 'an sādatinā Abī Bakrin wa-'Umara wa-'Uthmāna wa-'Aliyyin wa-'ani-ṣ-ṣaḥābati ajma'īn, wa-'ani-t-tābi'īna wa-tābi'īhim bi-iḥsānin ilā yawmi-d-dīn
meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon our master Muhammad, Your servant, Prophet, and Messenger — the unlettered Prophet — and upon his family and companions, a greeting of peace by the number of what Your knowledge encompasses, what Your pen has written, and what Your Book has recorded. And be pleased, O Allah, with our masters Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali, and with all the Companions, and with the Followers and those who follow them in goodness until the Day of Judgment.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
latin: Subḥāna rabbika rabbi-l-'izzati 'ammā yaṣifūn, wa-salāmun 'ala-l-mursalīn, wa-l-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbi-l-'ālamīn
meaning: Glorified is your Lord, the Lord of Honor, above what they describe. And peace be upon the Messengers. And all praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
